# ADR 0002: A timeout is PENDING, resolved by status queries

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Interbank transfer gRPC service

## Context

A transfer can succeed at the receiving bank even when the response is lost.

## Decision

Deadline exceeded marks the transfer PENDING; a resolver queries TransactionStatus with backoff; only a definite failure reverses the debit.

## Consequences

No double payments or wrong reversals. Customers sometimes wait for a final status.

## Alternatives considered

Reverse on timeout.
